verse.text: A final word: Be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.

reflection: Every dad hits days when he's running on empty—patience gone, temper short, energy tapped out. This verse is a reminder that leading your family well was never meant to run on your own horsepower; it's God's strength you're plugged into. So before you walk in the door tonight, take one breath and ask Him to fill what you don't have left to give.
